source_text: Lemma Luke 5:33-39. (Jerome Latin per Rauer GCS 35; working note for condensed tip.)
pass_a_gloss: Homily 30 on Luke 5:33-39: Fasting and new wine (Luke 5:33-39)
pass_b_english: The bridegroom’s friends do not fast while he is with them. New wine needs new skins — the gospel’s joy is not patched onto old self-righteousness.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
